page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, set in italic. A fragment at the top continues the previous page. Numbered theses stand on their own lines, with headings in capitals. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the lower left. No page number and no running head.

p.i: ministranda sunt; gubernandi rationem eandem obtinent: ad gubernandas quoq; familias Politica studia non parũ utilitatis sunt, spero equidē, allatura. Xenophon eas multitudine tantùm & numero differre voluit.
Hæc quidē exortu est prior; Politica verò perfectione.
Ast quia variis insuper Legibus diversorum in Re familiari consyderandorum & constitutorum illa perficienda; nobis, ne Labyrinthum quendam ingrediamur, sufficiat huius admonuisse.

main_text.p: Unicum tamen addere visum est, Aristoteli decantatum: Patrem familiâs surgere decere Ante lucem, id est, Prudentissimum esse: quod & ad sanitatem, & ad rem familiarem locupletandam, & ad sapientiæ insuper studia eidem profuerit quamplurimum. 2.Oeconom.3.gen. bonor. Columell.l.ii.c.i.
main_text.head: POLITICA.

p.i: Laudatissima nunc succedit Politica, splendor huius Philosophiæ universus, & gloria deniq; tota.

main_text.p: Illa quidem in constituenda & tuenda Republica, & Legum quoq; expositione versatur: quæ quidem instrumenta sunt introducenda in civitatem, imò communem hominum vitam felicitatis. 1.Ethic.2.

p.i: Constituendæ verò Reipublicæ non una eademq; o-mnium est opinio; & proin diversæ quoq; Rerumpublica-rum formæ exoriuntur.
Legitimè tamen constitutas tres esse video, quæ & u-su etiamnum omnes sunt receptæ, & apud varias quoq; nationes alia atq; alia, rationibus etiam comprobatæ.

page.notes: Printing error kept as printed: "XXXIIX." in the thesis numbering (probably XXXVIII). The reference "Columell.l.ii.c.i." is small and hard to read; the numerals may be 11 and 1. The hyphen at the line end of "perficien-da" is not clearly visible; the word is written whole. "familiâs" carries a mark over the a as printed. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Catchword "Cùm" and signature "C 2" are taken from the foot of the page.
